steps: Parked Spear+Dagger from StarterPack into ServerStorage
generate_mesh a falchion (forward-curving single-edged clipped-tip blade, 3.4 studs)
save_mesh to make it durable (survives Play)
make_tool with the mesh as Handle at the hilt

recipe.text: Distinct concept: a medieval FALCHION — broad forward-curving single-edged chopping blade with a clipped angular tip, cross guard, wrapped grip, round pommel — distinct from prior daggers/spears/scimitars. Cube-generated mesh (~3.4 studs, hand scale) saved durable via save_mesh (asset 75364272787286). make_tool used the single mesh as Handle. Fast-swing behavior (0.10/0.12/0.30) and a short-reach moderate-damage hitbox (22 dmg, 6 studs, 0.30s server cooldown) bound on the active window.
